title: Color Picker
content: Build color picker component. Preset swatches: grid of common colors. Custom: open spectrum picker for custom color. Display: show selected color in preview box. Formats: support HEX, RGB, HSL input. Eyedropper: optional browser eyedropper tool. Recent colors: remember recently used colors. Opacity: optional alpha channel slider. Input: manual hex input field.

variants.simple: Create color picker with swatches and custom color option.
variants.detailed: Build color picker component. Preset swatches: grid of common colors. Custom: open spectrum picker for custom color. Display: show selected color in preview box. Formats: support HEX, RGB, HSL input. Eyedropper: optional browser eyedropper tool. Recent colors: remember recently used colors. Opacity: optional alpha channel slider. Input: manual hex input field.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive color picker component. Trigger: button showing current color swatch, click to open picker. Picker layout: dropdown or popover with multiple sections. Preset swatches: grid of preset colors (Tailwind palette or custom), click to select, hover shows color name. Custom color section: spectrum/gradient area for hue/saturation, separate slider for lightness/value, vertical hue strip. Opacity slider: optional alpha channel slider (0-100%), checkerboard background showing transparency. Color formats: toggle between HEX (#FF5733), RGB (rgb(255, 87, 51)), HSL (hsl(14, 100%, 60%)), manual input for each with validation. Preview: side-by-side current vs new color comparison. Eyedropper: EyeDropper API (where supported) to pick color from screen, graceful fallback where unsupported. Recent colors: store last 8-10 used colors in localStorage, show at top of picker. Favorite colors: allow saving colors to favorites, persist across sessions. Copy value: click to copy color value in current format. Named colors: optionally support CSS named colors (red, navy, coral). Color contrast: show WCAG contrast ratio when applicable. Gradients: optional gradient builder (two-color picker with direction). Keyboard navigation: arrow keys in swatches, Tab through sections. Accessibility: announce color selections, ARIA for picker controls. Close: click outside, Escape, or confirm button. Implementation: consider react-color, @radix-ui/react-popover, or custom. Mobile: full-screen modal picker, larger touch targets.
